question: accidently clicked won on a deal that isnt actually done yet, can i undo that

articles.title: Reopen a won or lost deal
articles.body:
1. Go to **Deals** and open the won or lost deal.
2. Select **Reopen deal**.

The deal returns to the **Negotiation** stage, and its close date and lost reason are cleared.

articles.title: Mark a deal as won
articles.body:
1. Go to **Deals** and open the deal.
2. Select **Mark as won**.

The deal moves to the **Won** column and its close date is set to today. To undo it, select **Reopen deal**.

answer:
Yes, you can undo it by reopening the deal:

1. Go to **Deals** and open the won deal.
2. Select **Reopen deal**.

The deal returns to the **Negotiation** stage, and its close date is cleared.
